California Lemon Law Resources

Lemon law information by manufacturer and by defect, plus how buybacks are calculated. Manufacturer pays attorney fees when you win. Free case review: 323-452-5222.

Call 323-452-5222Free Case Review
★★★★★ 5.0 on Google Former insurance company trial attorney No fee unless we win We speak Armenian · Español

If your new or leased vehicle keeps going back to the dealer for the same problem, California's lemon law may require the manufacturer to buy it back, replace it, or pay you cash. Start with our California lemon law overview, or jump to your brand or problem below.

Don't see your brand? California lemon law covers every manufacturer.
